TextBlock.Text: GULF OF PAPUA, first light. MV Kerema Trader sailed independent - Santos's people call it going without - and went down at 2140 last night with twenty-six aboard, forty miles off the convoy track. Eleven are accounted for. The rest are somewhere inside a drift box that has been growing all night. HOBART is detached from the escort task with a Seahawk. The boat that did it has not left the area - it is inside torpedo range of the ship - and the search pattern you need to fly is exactly the pattern it will expect. Work the box for the full thirty minutes, whatever you find, and then bring the helicopter home. If the boat presents itself, that is a bonus and not the reason you are here.
This one pays nothing and I would fly it anyway. Work the box to its northern edge. Bring the helicopter home. The people we do not find today we will not find.
Survivors: Work the drift box for the full thirty minutes, then recover the helicopter Helicopter: Bring the search helicopter home Assist: Do not lose an assisting merchant or harm other traffic
HMAS Hobart and one MH-60R on the search. One Type 039C still in the area. Two merchant hulls diverted to assist.
45 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.
Destroying a neutral contact ends the operation in failure. Identify before you shoot.
MH-60R Seahawk, Auxiliary Merchant Pack, RE-power: the resupply mod, PLAN Submarines, this pack.
